evidence: Modifies src/span.h to add compile-time lifetime annotations to core span utility functions
rationale: Adds Clang lifetimebound annotations to MakeByteSpan and MakeUCharSpan to diagnose dangling views from temporary containers. Per the description, this prevents developers from 'accidentally bind[ing] views to temporary owning objects that immediately dangle without any compiler warnings.' It improves compile-time safety across shared utilities, but is reasonably deferrable internal hygiene.
